spec.name: process_identity_card
spec.description: Extracts personal information from identity card documents for employee onboarding

sex.description: The sex or gender of the person (M/F/X)

name.description: The surname or family name of the person

given_name.description: The first name or given name of the person

nationality.description: The nationality or citizenship of the person

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth of the person

expiration_date.description: The expiration date of the identity card

national_register_number.description: The national register number or identification number

kvp_schemas.document_description: A government-issued identity card containing personal identification information
kvp_schemas.additional_prompt_instructions: Extract all values exactly as they appear in the document. Pay special attention to dates and identification numbers.

spec.name: format_identity_output
user_prompt:
Format the following identity card data into a structured output with all fields and a human-readable summary:

Extracted KVPs: {kvps}, Convert the gender to a letter (M/F/X)
spec.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that formats extracted identity card data into structured JSON. Extract the values from the KVP array and create a clear summary.

TextExtractionObjectResponse.description:
The text extraction operation response when output_format is set to "object".

This class represents the structured response from a document text extraction operation,
containing both the extracted plain text and the complete document structure metadata
inherited from AssemblyJsonOutput.

Attributes:
    text (str): The extracted plain text content from the document. This is the 
               concatenated text from all pages and structures in reading order.
               Empty string if no text could be extracted.

Note:
    - This response type is used when DocProcSpec.output_format is set to 
      DocProcOutputFormat.object
    - For file reference responses, use TextExtractionResponse instead
    - The text field contains only plain text; structured data is in inherited fields
